paragraphs.text: Hamster is a rarely used creature type for a species of small burrowing rodents with a stout body, relatively short ears, a short tail, and large cheek pouches for carrying food.
The only hamster printed is mono- white , but most genrated hamster tokens are mono- red .
Hamster first appeared in Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms with the token creature Boo .
Bloomburrow introduced the first non-token hamster ( Jolly Gerbils ) while the Animated Army commander deck introduced the first hamster token not associated with D&D ' s Boo .
